quest.title: Kano Nana's Healthy Diet
quest.description: Narukami Island's Kano Nana would like to have 15 carrots.

talks.objective: Give fifteen Carrots to Kano Nana

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Were you looking for some Carrots?

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Kids have gotta learn to eat their vegetables if they want to grow up. You can't be a picky eater, even when it comes to Carrots.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Anyway. You must be the one who accepted my commission? Do you have 15 Carrots for me?

response.speaker: Kano Nana
response.text: Okay. Well, I'll be waiting here once you've got them.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Good, great, excellent. This time, I'm gonna watch that kid until she's eaten every last mouthful.
